title: Linear equation of a constraint
statement: Let $r$ be a natural number and let $V$ be a finite set with decidable equality. A constraint over the maximum linear template of arity bound $r$ determines an equation over the binary field whose coefficient at a variable is $1$ if that variable lies in the constraint's scope and $0$ otherwise, and whose constant is the predicate's right-hand side.
